findings.message: 3 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Site Links", "Contact", "Trading Hours").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(rgba(176, 161, 141, 0.55), rgba(48, 48, 48, 0.65)) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(rgba(176, 161, 141, 0.55), rgba(48, 48, 48, 0.65)) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(rgba(176, 161, 141, 0.55), rgba(48, 48, 48, 0.65))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 7 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.bg-white.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.bg-white.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.bg-white.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Cosmetic Tattooing on the Sunshine Coast" 2.4:1 (#c09569 on #f7f3ea); "Meet Your Artist" 2.4:1 (#c09569 on #f7f3ea)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Source Sans 3, Montserrat, Josefin Sans).

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Chillax and Chillax, but the page renders Source Sans 3, Montserrat.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 120px from the left edge but only to 10px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Kylie Roberts" (10px from the right); "6 months ago" (9px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Only 5 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 909px of nothing between: "Testimonials"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "COSMETIC TATTOOING ON THE SUNSHINE COAST" → 3 lines (6 words, 26px); "Welcome to My Cosmetic Tattoo Studio" → 3 lines (6 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 4 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Testimonials", "Eyebrows", "Eye Liners", "Lips"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
